skill: Infer two missing additive elementary column operations that zero the nonpivot entries of one row in a 4x4 matrix.
reasoning_steps: Identify the unchanged source column and row reduced to zeros in B.
For each missing target column solve a_ri + k a_rp = 0; confirm A[:,i]+k A[:,p]=B[:,i].
Select the pair of operations from five choices; follow three sequential matrices in the explanation.
response_contract: One radio selection containing two column operations; canonical example has no captured answer bank.
difficulty: Moderate: 4x4 integer matrices, three operations, one supplied and two missing; source pivots include 1,-1,2,-2,-3 with integral multipliers.
invariants: Source column remains unchanged and nonzero.
Three other columns each receive a multiple of the same source column.
Exactly two operations missing and one given; additive operations only.
Every displayed intermediate and final matrix follows the stated operations.
permitted_variations: All four pivot rows and columns, which of the three operations is supplied, signs and magnitudes of integer multipliers, nonpivot entries, and distractor order.
Pivot signs and small nonunit pivots are supported; preserve integer arithmetic and comparable size.
The signs, equality of the missing multipliers, and correct option position are incidental assignments, not fixed instructional constraints.
